title: tenant-defaults-propagator-and-override-cli
author: Maya Chen
description: Introduce a tenant-aware defaults propagator + a CLI for dry-run and selective rollout. Motivation: many customers want opinionated batching/caching/quantization defaults but with tenant-level overrides and staged rollouts. This PR adds a propagation service that takes a canonical defaults catalog and applies tenant-specific deltas, a redwoodctl subcommand to preview/apply propagation with a dry-run mode, and safety guards (circuit breaker, versioned manifests, and automatic rollback markers). The description below covers design, migration steps, and rollback plan. Design: 1) canonical defaults live in pkg/config/default_profiles.yaml (versioned); 2) the propagator service (svc/econ/propagator.go) computes tenant deltas from a tenant profile store and writes an occupant-ready manifest to the tenant-configs bucket; 3) redwoodctl defaults propagate --tenant <id> --dry-run prints a summarized diff and telemetry footprint (expected token savings, latency delta); 4) propagation is staged: preview -> apply-staging (small % of tenants) -> apply -> monitor. Safety: each propagate run attaches a rollout-id and tombstone marker; an explicit rollback command is supported. Migration: we ship a migration that seeds tenant profiles with conservative deltas derived from current runtime telemetry for a safe initial rollout. Backwards compatibility: if tenant overrides exist, propagation will only apply non-conflicting fields unless --force is used. Ops notes: a new metric econ.propagator.apply.success and a dashboard tile in Console were added.
